excerpt.zh:
这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
excerpt.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
texts.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

texts.zh:
从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。

每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。

我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。
texts.en:
The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.

Locked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themselves, effectively becoming a new organism entirely.

We can use these processes of genetic malleability against them.

# 虚空三头虫尸骸 / Voidworm Troika Remains

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Grand Archive · 来源 Sources：`events/grand_archive_events.txt:509-560`、`events/grand_archive_events.txt:2597-2615`、`common/special_projects/04_projects_grand_archive.txt:736-760`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1674` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在“虚空虫腺体”研究进行中击毁一只虚空三头虫（on_fleet_destroyed_perp，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1674）：隐藏事件 grand_archive.2040 要求击杀者正在进行 VOIDWORM_GLANDS_PROJECT，被毁方为敌对虚空虫国家，且被毁舰队正在轰炸。它中止该项目，在原地创建虚空虫尸骸环境物体，并启用 VOIDWORM_TITAN_DEBRIS_PROJECT。

Destroy a Voidworm Troika while the Voidworm glands project is running (on_fleet_destroyed_perp, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1674): hidden grand_archive.2040 needs the killer to be on VOIDWORM_GLANDS_PROJECT, the loser to be a hostile Voidworm country and the destroyed fleet to be bombarding. It aborts that project, creates a Voidworm carcass ambient object and enables VOIDWORM_TITAN_DEBRIS_PROJECT there.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

特殊项目“虚空三头虫尸骸”（40天、工程科技、需科学家与科学舰，04_projects_grand_archive.txt:739-757）完成后，grand_archive.2455“获得腺体”：选项“太棒了”给予团结月度加成，并给虚空虫瘟疫情境（situation_voidworm_plague）加100点进度。

The special project "Voidworm Troika Remains" (40 days, engineering, needs a scientist and science ship, 04_projects_grand_archive.txt:739-757) completes into grand_archive.2455 "Glands Recovered": the option Excellent gives a monthly unity bonus and adds 100 progress to the Voidworm Plague situation (situation_voidworm_plague).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。

No branches.

依赖正在进行的 VOIDWORM_GLANDS_PROJECT。

Depends on VOIDWORM_GLANDS_PROJECT being active.
